page.overview:
Who is Emmerololth?

Emmerololth is a character from Final Fantasy XIV. She was an Ascian introduced in patch 2.3 "Defenders of Eorzea", getting a major but unseen role in the Forbidden Land, Eureka.

Emmerololth was an ancient that was part of the Convocation of Fourteen of Amaurot, taking the title of "Emmerololth, the Mender". The seat of Emmerololth specialised in medicines and healing.

During the Final Days, Emmerololth alongside the rest of the Convocation, used creation magicks to give life to the the first deity concept, Zodiark, in order to stop the disaster. They did so by sacrificing half of the star's population to stop the Final Days, and another further half of the remaining population to restore life to the star. With new life being born, the Convocation planned on sacrificing newly emerged life to Zodiark that He might bring back their sacrificed brethren.

Wishing to avoid further sacrifices, a rival faction, led by Venat, summoned another deity, Hydaelyn, to keep Zodiark in check. During the battle between Zodiark and Hydaelyn, the star was sundered, split, into fourteen worlds: thirteen reflections and a Source, with all living beings on it split among them, with Emmerololth's soul was splintered into fourteen shards.
